name: @agent-ui/devtools
description: The chat & A2UI dev/debug harness (ADR-0200): a three-backend AgentTransport shelf (replay/script canned timelines, the existing /__a2ui/agent dev-proxy mount over HTTP only, an A2A peer over A2aChannel), backend descriptor rows, the DevtoolsEvent NDJSON timeline vocabulary + recordTurn, the DevtoolsCapture format, a dev-only ./server HTTP orchestration seam, and a types-only ./playwright helper. Zero third-party runtime deps; no key, provider adapter, or produce() ever enters this package (the ADR-0073 trust boundary stays at /__a2ui/agent).
